title: Kurabie Butter Cookies
hookLine: Global-inspired kurabie butter cookies with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large mixing bowl add all the ingredients and mix together until a dough is formed. The dough should be stick - add extra flour if you find the mixture too sticky to work with. Incorporate {m53414_1}, {m53414_2}, {m53414_3}, and {m53414_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Using the extra melted butter, rub some over your hands before breaking the dough into 20 equal sized pieces and roll each piece into a ball. Before rolling each ball rub melted butter over your hands each time. Incorporate {m53414_5}, {m53414_6}, {m53414_7}, {m53414_8}, and {m53414_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the balls of dough onto a greased / lined baking tray 5cm apart - you will need to split the balls into two batches cooking one batch at a time.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Brush eat ball with beaten egg and place in the oven at 180 degree for 20 minutes. The Kurabie will be a light golden colour and slightly squishy in the middle. Place on a cooling rack to cool.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
